title: Re'ee Warqee keessaa baafame
intro: Fakkiin Qur’aana keessatti caqafame tokko yeroo nabiyyiin kabajamaan tokko hin jirretti namoota baay’ee gara karaa irraa maquutti geesse. Wanti warqee irraa hojjetame tokko onnee saba guutuu booji’e — garuu seenaan nama dhuunfaa kanaa kophummaa fi abaarsa ajaa’ibaatiin xumurama. Namni biyyaa baafame kun eenyu taʼuu dandaʼa?
clues: Yeroo raajiin guddaan qajeelfama waaqaa argachuuf ol ba’e hin jirrettin mul’adhe.
Waan harka kootiin hojjedheen namoota baay’ee akka karaa irraa maqan taasiseera.
Uumamni warqee ani oomishes jireenya waan qabu fakkaata, sagalee warra isa hordofan booji’u oomishaa ture.
Waan warri kaan hubachuu hin dandeenye argeera jedheen himadhe — waan hin mul’anne ilaaluu.
Waan tokko daandii ergamaa waaqaa irraa kaaseen sibiilaa baqfameetti nan darbadhe.
Kophaa koo akkan naanna’u itti murtaa’e, abaarsa addaa kan namni tokkollee gogaa koo tuquu akka hin dandeenye, anis gogaa isaanii tuquu akka hin dandeenye.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Baqatamanii, tuqamuu ykn tuquu irraa dhoowwame
Qilleensi hamaa fi boo'aa ta'een rukutamee gadi bu'e
Dhiifama godhamee gara buufata ol’aanaatti ol guddate
outcome.answer: Baqatamanii, tuqamuu ykn tuquu irraa dhoowwame

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
